Use `MDIForm1.Arrange vbCascade` (or `vbTileHorizontal` / `vbTileVertical`) to reposition all open children. `MDIForm1.ActiveForm` gives you the currently active child form. If you add a menu item with **WindowList = True**, it will list all open child windows and let the user switch between them. The MDIForm has its own `MDIForm_Load` event and properties like `AutoShowChildren` (show children when the parent is shown) and `ScrollBars`. Child forms behave normally otherwise — they have their own controls, events, and can be closed independently.
